_note: Derived statistics from the MetroPT-3 dataset; see docs/dataset.md. REUSE: this JSON is annotated in REUSE.toml (CC-BY-4.0) because JSON has no comment syntax.

state_logic.rule: loaded = (COMP == 0 and DV_eletric == 1); unloaded = not loaded and Motor_current >= 1.0 A; off = not loaded and Motor_current < 1.0 A
state_logic.current_only_rule: loaded = Motor_current >= 4.6 A; unloaded = 1.0 <= Motor_current < 4.6 A; off = < 1.0 A
state_logic.frozen_rule: identical (TP2, TP3, H1, Oil_temperature, Motor_current) for >= 60 consecutive rows
